+@pytest.mark.sphinx('html', testroot='ext-autodoc')
+def test_autodoc_inherited_members_multiple(app):
+    """Test that inherited-members can accept multiple class names."""
+    options = {"members": None,
+               "inherited-members": "Base1,Base2",
+               "special-members": None}
+
+    # check methods for object class are shown
+    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.inheritance.MultiDerived', options)
+    # method3 should be shown (it's from MultiDerived)
+    assert '   .. py:method:: MultiDerived.method3()' in actual
+    # method1 and method2 should NOT be shown (they're from Base1 and Base2 which are filtered)
+    assert '   .. py:method:: MultiDerived.method1()' not in actual
+    assert '   .. py:method:: MultiDerived.method2()' not in actual
+    # classmeth1 and classmeth2 should NOT be shown (they're from Base1 and Base2 which are filtered)
+    assert '   .. py:method:: MultiDerived.classmeth1' not in actual
